description: Fetch full market snapshot for multiple crypto pairs (fsyms → tsyms): price, 24h change/%, volume, market cap, open/high/low from CoinDesk Data (formerly CryptoCompare). Requires your own CoinDesk Data API key.

_apiKey.description: Your own CoinDesk Data (formerly CryptoCompare) API key — required, Pipeworx does not supply one for this pack. Free signup: https://developers.coindesk.com/. Without a key, use the `crypto` pack (get_crypto_price) for prices/daily history or `crypto-feeds` for news instead.

name: price_full
